info.name: LOVO AI Genny API
info.description: REST API for LOVO AI's Genny text-to-speech and voice generation platform. Base URL: https://api.genny.lovo.ai. Every request is authenticated with the X-API-KEY header carrying a key generated at https://genny.lovo.ai (profile tab). API access requires an active subscription; TTS credits are deducted from the account. Rate limit is 20 requests/min, text is capped at 500 characters per conversion, and generated audio URLs are valid for 24 hours.

request.description: Submit an asynchronous text-to-speech job. Returns a job with an id to poll via GET /tts/{jobId}. Optionally supply callbackUrls (max 4) to receive a POST webhook on completion.
Convert text to speech synchronously. Has a 90-second timeout; if synthesis is not complete in time it returns a pending async job to poll.
Retrieve a TTS job by id. Returns generated audio URLs (valid 24 hours) once the job is completed.

query.description: Sort by displayName, locale, gender, speakerType, or ageRange. No whitespace.

request.description: Retrieve all speakers with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination. Each speaker includes id, locale, gender, avatar, age range, and available styles with sample audio URLs.
Get team billing and usage information for the account associated with the API key - team name, subscription status/interval, current period, and metered usage.
